name: Discrete Ordinates Method
aliases: Discrete Ordinates Method with Direction Bins
definition: A method for solving the radiative transfer equation by using a collection of M discrete directions chosen to give optimal Gaussian quadrature in integrals over a solid angle. It approximates the directional intensity distribution.
summary: The Discrete Ordinates Method solves the Radiative Transfer Equation by approximating radiance with discrete direction bins, mitigating ray effects while computing multiple scattering in participating media.
